items.prompt: State (a) the meanings of representation and delegation [2]. Explain (b) why an invented transfer of water-service tasks without staff or funds may not improve local access [4].
items.canonical_answer: (a) Acting for others; assigning specified responsibilities within limits. (b) Transferring tasks gives the local body responsibility for water services and may bring decisions closer to users. It does not itself create trained operators, so maintenance and reliable operation can remain impossible. Missing funds separately prevent the purchase of supplies and payment for necessary work. Transfer should therefore be accompanied by defined resources, skills and accountability; measure reliable access for residents rather than assuming that a change of responsibility improves services.
marking_guidance: Point: correct meanings [2].
Development: connect transferred tasks and missing means to the service outcome [4].
Original indicative practice guidance; not an official mark scheme.
